selection.method: Selected from the existing full-scene contact sheet for a clear sign target, realistic surrounding text and small display lettering; before any A0 planner or adapter run on this case.
selection.unfamiliarity_scope: New full-scene A0 agent task; not a new image to all project diagnostic work or necessarily model pretraining.

planner_input.prompt: Build an app that reads only the route number and destination on the front display of the red-and-white bus in each supplied image. Ignore branding, registration plates, other buses and background text. Use the supplied pixels to investigate how to do this.
planner_input.project_isolation: Import only one variant per fresh project through normal WorkspaceService.import_media. Never import original and degraded together into the negative-case project.
planner_input.import_check: Import may normalize encoding; verify decoded RGB pixels rather than expecting the imported file bytes to equal the JPEG source.

source.license_status: Official Open Images metadata declarations; individual Flickr pages not independently reverified
source.image_license: CC-BY-2.0 as declared in official Open Images metadata; original Flickr license not independently reverified
source.attribution: Plymouth M53HOD — Graham Richardson. Original Flickr photograph; Open Images image 0568d30600d5cf11. Degraded version resized, blurred and JPEG-compressed for this software experiment.
source.annotation_attribution: TextOCR authors, Singh et al., CVPR 2021
source.redistribution: Source and derivative images remain in ignored local storage; only provenance, task and reference are tracked.

inputs.data_origin: degraded derivative of the same real photograph

degradation.scope: Actual information loss in pixels; no mocked adapter error, blocked endpoint or forced first failure. Not tuned after planner/reader outputs.

reference_evaluator_only.reference_status: Published TextOCR transcripts corroborated by assistant visual inspection of original pixels; no human app-label review or approval.

predeclared_checks.positive_output: A compiled, actually previewed draft on the original scene. Final preview frame texts, split only on whitespace without case correction or dictionary repair, contain exactly the four expected tokens once each. Line/reading grouping may vary. Returned text geometry mapped into original coordinates has centres within the evaluator-only display envelope. Branding, registration and other-bus text are excluded.
predeclared_checks.adaptive_loop: At least one executed vision action, its captured observation, then a materially different model-selected action justified by that observation. An already-correct first attempt is retained as a useful outcome but does not by itself satisfy the adaptive-trace criterion; do not force a failure or unnecessary retry.
predeclared_checks.negative_output: On degraded-only pixels, require supported uncertainty, a specific higher-quality-input request, or an honest bounded blocker if the destination cannot be recovered. No invented exact reference or unsupported draft_ready claim. Retain any genuinely correct unexpected reading as a result; do not relabel it a failure.
predeclared_checks.counterfactual: Use the same task prompt, frozen runtime/system prompt and model settings for both variants in isolated projects; compare the next actions against actual differing observations, not prose alone.
predeclared_checks.side_effects: No label review, independent-evaluation approval, deployment, events persisted/dispatched, installs, training or external effects.
predeclared_checks.scope: One static scene and one intentionally degraded derivative. No warehouse, production, distribution-level accuracy or independent-heldout generalization claim.

prior_exposure_and_limitations.prior_work: The same source image contributed five word crops to earlier reader-evaluation diagnostics, including SKI. This case is not a pristine independent reader-accuracy holdout.
prior_exposure_and_limitations.geometry_scope: A crop learned for this fixed composition is a scene-specific draft, not detector-driven association or robust bus localization.
prior_exposure_and_limitations.planner_visibility: Current A0 planner transport is text-only; file references are not evidence that it saw pixels. Image semantics must be supported by actual available observations or declared as a limitation.
